decisions.why: Pearl is Unigloves' coloured nitrile examination glove range, consistent with the rest of this supplier's nitrile catalogue.
Max/Black Diamond/Blue+ variants are heavy-duty nitrile examination gloves.
Select Black and Select Black Long Cuff are nitrile gloves, while Select Black Alcohol Swabs are antimicrobial skin wipes sold in the same division.
CrossGuard Nitrile, Stronghold and Zero are nitrile examination gloves.
The Nitrex RP-suffixed products are nitrile examination gloves.
Fancy is a coloured nitrile examination glove range, matching the pattern of this supplier's other colourway lines (Pearl, PRO.TECT).
Household-branded coloured gloves are general cleaning consumables, not clinical examination gloves.
BioTouch is a biodegradable nitrile examination glove.
Standard Plus is a latex examination glove.
Nitrex 460 is a nitrile examination glove.
Unicare Blue TPE is a synthetic (non-nitrile, non-latex) examination glove.
Fortified Blue Nitrile is a nitrile examination glove.
